instruction: Hi! I'm HEXON. Welcome to Omarchy. A few good shortcuts can change how you work: opening apps, moving between workspaces, and keeping everything within reach. You'll learn by doing, with guidance when you need it. Start with a quick tour, or choose something you want to get better at. Find what works for you. Your desktop. Your way.
